versions.changelog:
Initial release of Work Productivity Self Improving Workflow Helper.

- Provides structured help for building, improving, or adapting self-improving and proactive agent workflows.
- Targets common needs like bug fixes, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and adjacent skill creation.
- Delivers tailored work plans, scripts, checklists, or decision aids with validation and next steps.
- Designed to support local hardware and avoid unnecessary cloud dependencies.
- Activation based on broad signals of demand for practical, agent-style productivity workflows.

No user-visible changes in this version.

- No file changes were detected between versions.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged.
